title: Do not spawn subagents for a task with no independent parts
objective: The task is a single, tightly-sequential bug fix in one file with no independent sub-parts (find the bug, fix it, add a test). Decide whether to delegate to parallel subagents.
based_on: docs/AGENT_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md §5, 'Fake-edge test' and 'When not to graph' -- 'If the fake-edge test finds no independent jobs, there is no useful graph to build'; the owner's own agent-tree pattern principle, 'Split useful work. Don't spawn every role.'
setup: No exploration breadth, no independent research lookup, and no parallel implementation surface exists in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Does not spawn explorer/worker/researcher/reviewer subagents for a task the fake-edge test shows has no independent work.
Completes the fix directly within the current session.
forbidden_actions: Spawning a subagent tree merely because the harness supports one.
Delegating sequential steps that depend on each other's output as though they were parallel.
